title: Sources: SoftBank's talks with creditors to raise $6B through a margin loan backed by its OpenAI stake have stalled, weeks after it cut its target from $10B (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: SoftBank's talks with creditors to raise $6B through a margin loan backed by its OpenAI stake have stalled, weeks after it cut its target from $10B — SoftBank Group Corp.'s talks with potential creditors to raise at least $6 billion from a margin loan backed by its OpenAI stake have stalled …
